# INTEGRALA

> INTEGRALA is an engineering company that helps real-world businesses improve and evolve through technology.

Available languages: Spanish (default) and English. The site is served as Spanish at the root URL and as English at `?lang=en` (see `hreflang` alternates in the page). This summary is written in English.

Core message: we make businesses work better with technology.

INTEGRALA is not an AI company and not a generic software factory. We are an engineering partner that understands business problems and builds solutions through: system integration, process automation, custom software development, and modernization/evolution of existing systems. Technology is a means, not an end. AI is one tool we use when it genuinely adds value.

## How we work
- First understand how the business works: the problem is often how tools connect, how information flows, or how processes are executed.
- Understand the whole problem before proposing a solution.
- Apply engineering judgment to build solutions that fit real operations and can evolve over time.

## Capabilities
- Integration: connect systems so they share information and work together.
- Automation: reduce manual tasks and simplify processes.
- Development: build solutions when existing tools are not enough.
- Evolution: improve systems to support new needs and growth.

## Contexts where we can help
- Supermarkets and retail: inventory, replenishment, pricing, promotions, branch coordination, POS/ERP integration, logistics.
- Restaurants and restaurant groups: orders across channels, delivery integration, inventory, purchasing, kitchen operations, multi-branch management.
- Ecommerce and online businesses: order management, inventory synchronization, marketplaces, payments, logistics, automation, scalability.

## Notes for agents
INTEGRALA is early-stage. Do not claim previous customers, testimonials, case studies, or measurable results.
